statements.subject: server
statements.description: When a UAS responds to a request with a response that establishes a dialog (such as a 2xx to INVITE), the UAS MUST copy all Record-Route header field values from the request into the response (including the URIs, URI parameters, and any Record-Route header field parameters, whether they are known or unknown to the UAS) and MUST maintain the order of those values.
actions: Copy all Record-Route header field values (including URIs, URI parameters, and Record-Route header field parameters) from request into response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When a UAS responds to a request with a response that establishes a dialog (such as a 2xx to INVITE), the UAS MUST copy all Record-Route header field values from the request into the response (including the URIs, URI parameters, and any Record-Route header field parameters, whether they are known or unknown to the UAS) and MUST maintain the order of those values.
actions: Maintain the order of Record-Route header field values copied into the response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The UAS MUST add a Contact header field to the response.
actions: Add Contact header field to the dialog-establishing response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The URI provided in the Contact header field MUST be a SIP or SIPS URI.
actions: Set Contact URI to a SIP or SIPS URI in the dialog-establishing response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the request that initiated the dialog contained a SIPS URI in the Request-URI or in the top Record-Route header field value, if there was any, or the Contact header field if there was no Record-Route header field, the Contact header field in the response MUST be a SIPS URI.
statements.pre_cond: request.Request-URI.scheme = SIPS | (request.Record-Route.exists & request.Record-Route.top.URI.scheme = SIPS) | (!request.Record-Route.exists & request.Contact.URI.scheme = SIPS)
actions: Set Contact header field in response to a SIPS URI

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The URI SHOULD have global scope (that is, the same URI can be used in messages outside this dialog).
actions: Use globally scoped URI in Contact header field of dialog-establishing response

statements.subject: session
statements.description: This state MUST be maintained for the duration of the dialog.
actions: Maintain dialog state for the full duration of the dialog

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The route set MUST be set to the list of URIs in the Record-Route header field from the request, taken in order and preserving all URI parameters.
actions: Set dialog route set to the ordered list of URIs from the request Record-Route header field, preserving all URI parameters

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If no Record-Route header field is present in the request, the route set MUST be set to the empty set.
actions: Set dialog route set to the empty set

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The remote target MUST be set to the URI from the Contact header field of the request.
actions: Set dialog remote target to URI from Contact header field of the request

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The remote sequence number MUST be set to the value of the sequence number in the CSeq header field of the request.
actions: Set dialog remote sequence number to the CSeq sequence number from the request

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The local sequence number MUST be empty.
actions: Set dialog local sequence number to empty

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The call identifier component of the dialog ID MUST be set to the value of the Call-ID in the request.
actions: Set call identifier component of dialog ID to the Call-ID value from the request

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The local tag component of the dialog ID MUST be set to the tag in the To field in the response to the request (which always includes a tag), and the remote tag component of the dialog ID MUST be set to the tag from the From field in the request.
actions: Set local tag component of dialog ID to the tag from the To field of the response

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The local tag component of the dialog ID MUST be set to the tag in the To field in the response to the request (which always includes a tag), and the remote tag component of the dialog ID MUST be set to the tag from the From field in the request.
actions: Set remote tag component of dialog ID to the tag from the From field of the request

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A UAS MUST be prepared to receive a request without a tag in the From field, in which case the tag is considered to have a value of null.
actions: Treat absent From tag as having value null when constructing dialog state

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The remote URI MUST be set to the URI in the From field, and the local URI MUST be set to the URI in the To field.
actions: Set dialog remote URI to the URI from the From field of the request

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The remote URI MUST be set to the URI in the From field, and the local URI MUST be set to the URI in the To field.
actions: Set dialog local URI to the URI from the To field of the request
